description: Performance baselines for the vesting-cliff-drip-stream contract. All values are upper bounds. CI fails if any metric exceeds threshold * (1 + regression_threshold). Update this file via a PR with a written justification in the PR description.

wasm_instruction_counts._note: CPU instruction counts measured by the Soroban host-side budget API (env.budget().cpu_instruction_cost()) running Rust natively. WASM counts are typically 2-5x higher. These baselines reflect Rust-native test execution and should be updated after any significant contract logic change.

http_response_times._note: p99 latency in milliseconds measured by autocannon against a local Soroban RPC node (quickstart). These are expected in CI against the Docker-based local node started in the performance workflow. Not measured against public testnet.

lighthouse._note: Lighthouse scores are 0-100. CI fails if any score drops below the threshold. Scores are measured against a production build served locally.
